resource_pack.description: 1.21.1 原版覆寫：殭屍改為三眼蘑菇殭屍（皮膚 + 殭屍音效）
resource_pack.icon_prompt: Minecraft in-game style, one giant mob head filling almost the entire square canvas edge-to-edge like a scaled-up player head icon, chunky blocky pixels, mushroom zombie face: bright red fly agaric cap with big white spots covering top, three small eyes in a horizontal row on the face front, creepy fungal skin, no torso no shoulders no neck, minimal void gray background only in extreme corners if needed, no frame, no text, no UI

texture_overrides.texture_prompt: 64×64 mob skin. RULE 1 — THREE eyes: draw them ONLY inside the HEAD-FRONT 8×8 box at x=8..15, y=8..15 (horizontal row, centered). Never put eyes at y<8 or on torso/limb squares. RULE 2 — Red mushroom: scarlet/crimson cap on HAT layers (x=40..47,y=0..7 top plus y=8..15 front) with cream spots; face skin reddish-fungal only in the head-front box. RULE 3 — Torso/limbs: deep red/brown rags, NO teal shirt, NO neon purple pants. Whole skin reads RED mushroom horror. Hard Minecraft pixels.
